verdict.rationale: Evidence covers SmartScan receipt capture (expensify-docs-6) and card spend controls (expensify-docs-10, expensify-docs-5) but there is no documentation of automatic matching of receipts to card transactions, e-receipt pull-through from vendor integrations, or a 'nudge only when missing' notification flow; community evidence even flags manual, inconsistent data entry (expensify-comm-10) and categorization errors (expensify-comm-1) rather than confirming matching accuracy.
